architecture: FOSP-ARX-v2-DIRECT (factoradic-order SwiGLU path with direct cross-role gate)

supersedes_for_future_execution_only.repair: Remove the three separate-role marginal-KLT early kill. The first scientific gate is now the exact full cross-role 3x3 pair family itself.
supersedes_for_future_execution_only.counterexample_closed: The cyclic role-shift construction from the v1 audit reaches the direct stage because no statistic omitting cross-neuron cross-role covariance may stop it.

objective.metric: independently decoded pooled squared error against original BF16 Gate rows, Up rows, and Down columns in original coordinates

exact_symmetry.function_identity: down'*(silu(G'*x) elementwise_mul U'*x) = down*(silu(G*x) elementwise_mul U*x)

metric_compatibility.reason: A canonical orbit representative does not reveal the original arbitrary neuron labels required by the frozen MSE metric.
metric_compatibility.eligible_repair: serialize a fixed-width 783-byte big-endian factoradic rank in the one expert frame and scatter all decoded roles through its inverse before scoring
metric_compatibility.payload_steganography_rule: Any decoder-visible choice carrying order information consumes physical rate even if it is not named as a side stream.

eligible_physical_bridge.coefficient_format: IEEE-754 binary16 little-endian in path-edge order, then target-role-major/predecessor-role-minor order
eligible_physical_bridge.anchor_and_residual_quantization: paid from the residual payload reservoir; not implemented by this opportunity gate
decoder_order: read one local expert frame and one pessimistic shared-manifest page
unrank the fixed-width inline factoradic field
for each of 767 edges read nine inline FP16 coefficients and decode one joint residual
retain only the previous joint BF16 neuron while traversing the path
scatter Gate and Up rows and Down columns to original labels before MSE scoring

pair_model.degrees_of_freedom: exactly nine coefficients per selected edge; no intercept and no coordinate-wise parameters

relaxed_containing_upper_bound.construction: Each of all 768 targets independently chooses its best non-self predecessor with exact coefficients; predecessor reuse, cycles, and absence of an anchor are allowed.
relaxed_containing_upper_bound.why_containing: Every legal 767-edge path selects a subset of these target-wise choices and must pay one uncaptured anchor, so its exact regression capture cannot exceed the relaxed sum.
relaxed_containing_upper_bound.claim_boundary: This contains the frozen linear path family only. It is not a converse for nonlinear or higher-order codecs.

achievable_path.construction: maximum-weight non-self cycle cover, deterministic weakest-edge cut per cycle, deterministic segment ordering, and explicit bridge edges
achievable_path.optimality: not claimed; failure with a surviving relaxed bound is an ambiguity, not a hard kill
achievable_path.selection_arithmetic: exact float64 3x3 regression is an optimistic oracle used to select the path
achievable_path.finite_replay: all selected coefficients are rounded to FP16 and residual energy is recomputed directly; coefficient bytes are hashed
achievable_path.survival_condition: both the gross FP16 legal path and its optimistic control-corrected statistic reach 0.1858070514584381 bpw
achievable_path.survival_means: only that a finite residual-codec experiment is justified; no compressed-stream result exists

controls.construction: For every expert and neuron separately, preserve all three role means and the exact centered 3x3 Gate/Up/Down Gram while randomizing only centered orientation in the 2048-coordinate subspace.
controls.uncertainty: control Monte Carlo standard error combined in quadrature with a delete-one-expert jackknife standard error
controls.source_specific_credit: Only excess over identically optimized controls is credited.

early_stop_rules: If gross relaxed exact qwen s is below 0.1858070514584381, stop before controls: no legal charged path can survive.
If the control-corrected relaxed upper confidence statistic is below 0.1858070514584381, hard-kill the frozen linear path family.
If the relaxation survives but legal FP16 misses, report ambiguity and do not overclaim a family kill.
If legal FP16 survives, stop at a source-oracle survivor and require a separately frozen residual codec.

rate_and_read.cold_page_formula: (ceil(frame_bytes/4096)+1)*4096/frame_bytes; +1 is a pessimistic uncached shared-manifest page

numeric_backend.assignment: scipy.optimize.linear_sum_assignment after copying only the 768x768 score matrix to host
numeric_backend.coefficient_replay: round exact selected coefficients through cupy.float16 and back to float64 before direct residual evaluation

source.source_files: opened without following the final symlink; every parent component is rejected if symlinked; bytes decoded are the same descriptor bytes that were hashed

independent runtime-receipt audit proving zero payload access
required_after_auxiliary_survival: freeze a finite residual quantizer whose header/map/FP16 coefficients and residual bytes fit the same frame
